query: I just got back from taking my golden retriever to the dog park this afternoon, he had so much fun chasing after a frisbee and even made friends with a little poodle puppy that kept stealing his tennis ball. On the way home I stopped at that new bakery on 5th Street and picked up a lemon blueberry scone, it was still warm and tasted so much better than the ones I usually get at the grocery store. I was actually in the middle of texting my friend to tell her about the scone when I realized my mobile service isn’t working at all. I have airplane mode turned on right now, my APN settings seem to be messed up, my SIM card is locked with a PIN I can’t remember, the line is probably suspended because I forgot to pay my last bill, and I think the SIM card might have gotten unseated when I dropped my phone earlier this week.
